name: phase0-v1
notes: Importance is the smallest top-norm set covering 95% separately within heads and MLP groups, not a causal label
Cost caps include mandatory base matmuls, two dense initial layers and each predictor's estimated matmul cost
Nominal caps are anchored to the binary model's gated fractions; other methods receive the same total modeled cost cap
Masks represent exogenous budgeted censoring of dense activations, not closed-loop sparse student trajectories
Train masks refresh each epoch; validation and test masks are fixed and shared across methods
Primary decision requires binary to beat a validation-selected static baseline by >=1 point with positive paired CI and be within 2 points of hidden with paired CI
No tuning on test; three seeds and document-clustered uncertainty; do not proceed to end-to-end training automatically
